  "severity": "critical",
  "source": "tinh-hoa-dong-tien analysis 2026-05-15",

  "id": "RF-016",

  "trigger": "(total_intermediary_fees + platform_fees + interest) > 0.20 * revenue",
  "action": "AUDIT all fee layers: platform (Shopee 15-25%), intermediary markup (15%), loan interest (10-12%). Cut 1 layer = recover 5-15% margin. You are working for intermediaries, not yourself.",
  "severity": "high",
  "source": "tinh-hoa-dong-tien analysis 2026-05-15",
  "evidence": "Saygin fee drag principle: 1% annual fee = 33% total wealth loss over 40 years. Applied to VN business: Shopee 15-25% + intermediary 15% + interest = 30-50% revenue leaked"
},
{
  "id": "RF-017",
  "name": "chi_phi_co_dinh_qua_cao",
  "trigger": "(fixed_costs / revenue) > 0.40",
  "action": "RESTRUCTURE: convert fixed to variable. Full-time to part-time in slow months. Lease to hourly rental. In-house to outsource. Break-even too high = death in low season.",
  "severity": "high",
  "source": "tinh-hoa-dong-tien analysis 2026-05-15",
  "evidence": "Xuong in an example: 80M fixed costs, break-even 133M/month. Month Tet 50M revenue = -50M loss. Restructured to 35M fixed = break-even 58M, survives low season"
},
{
  "id": "RF-018",
  "name": "ccc_qua_dai",
  "trigger": "(DIO + DSO - DPO) > 30",
  "action": "Reduce CCC: (1) cut slow-moving inventory, (2) demand faster payment or COD, (3) negotiate longer supplier terms via trust-building. Target CCC < 15 days. CCC negative = ideal.",
  "severity": "high",
  "source": "tinh-hoa-dong-tien analysis 2026-05-15",
  "evidence": "VN VLXD store: CCC 30 days = 12 capital turns/year. CCC reduced to -10 days = infinite turns, business runs on supplier money"
},
{
  "id": "RF-019",
  "name": "khong_biet_unit_economics",
  "trigger": "(running_business) AND NOT(knows_cost_per_unit) AND NOT(knows_breakeven_daily)",
  "action": "STOP everything. Calculate: cost per unit, contribution margin, daily break-even quantity. Cannot make decisions without these 3 numbers.",
  "severity": "critical",
  "source": "tinh-hoa-dong-tien analysis 2026-05-15",
  "evidence": "Tiem giat ui: 20K/kg revenue, 5.8K variable cost, 14.2K margin, break-even 52 kg/day. WITHOUT this math, owner cannot decide pricing, marketing spend, or expansion"
},
{
  "id": "RF-020",
  "name": "scale_test_fail",
  "trigger": "(business_advice_received) AND (advice_only_works_at_scale > 100M_USD)",
  "action": "REJECT advice. Apply Scale Test: does this work at $0 capital AND $100M? If only at $100M = not applicable to you. 'Khong mac ca voi ngan hang' = only works when you borrow $500M, not 500M VND.",
  "severity": "medium",
  "source": "tinh-hoa-dong-tien analysis 2026-05-15",
  "evidence": "Diamond Resorts 'dont negotiate with banks' = valid at $500M loan. At 500M VND loan, bank earns 250K/year from you = you are noise, MUST negotiate"
},
{
  "id": "RF-021",
  "name": "lieu_het_kelly_violation",
  "trigger": "(investment_amount / total_capital) > 0.30",
  "action": "REDUCE position. Kelly Criterion: even with 60% win probability, optimal bet = 20% bankroll. Betting 100% = 92.2% ruin probability after 5 attempts. Keep 70% = survive to try again.",
  "severity": "critical",
  "source": "tinh-hoa-dong-tien analysis 2026-05-15",
  "evidence": "Cannabis billionaire 'kiem 10 lieu het kiem 20' violates Kelly. VCCI 2023: 49.5% VN businesses die within 5 years, primary cause = het von"
},
{
  "id": "RF-022",
  "name": "thue_sales_truoc_khi_tu_ban",
  "trigger": "(hiring_salesperson) AND (founder_direct_sales_conversations < 50)",
  "action": "STOP hiring. Founder MUST do 50+ direct sales conversations first. Only founder understands product deeply enough to discover product-market fit. Delegating sales before PMF = delegating cash flow to someone who doesn't understand the product.",
  "severity": "high",
  "source": "tinh-hoa-dong-tien analysis 2026-05-15",

    {

      "condition": "Business has both supplier relationships (DPO negotiable) AND customer payment control (DSO reducible)",
      "heuristic": "VN SMEs can achieve negative CCC in services and retail within 6-12 months IF they pay suppliers fast first (build TIN) then negotiate longer terms. Sequence: pay fast 3 months -> request 15-day terms -> 6 months -> 30-day terms -> 12 months -> 45-day terms.",
      "confidence": 0.7,

    },
    {
      "id": "DH-CF-002",
      "name": "VAT Float Window",
      "condition": "Business collects 10% VAT from customers and remits quarterly",
      "heuristic": "3-month VAT float = free working capital. On 500M quarterly revenue, VAT float = 50M for up to 90 days. Place in online savings (5% pa) = 625K free income. OR use as working capital to avoid short-term borrowing at 10-12% pa = save 1.25-1.5M per quarter.",
      "confidence": 0.8,
      "evidence": "Standard VN tax code. Risk: late filing penalties if float is spent and cannot be repaid. Legal but requires discipline."
    },
    {
      "id": "DH-CF-003",

Value of TIN for 100M monthly purchases: 100M x 45 days / 30 = 150M interest-free capital. Lost TIN = lost access to this capital = need 150M additional own capital.",
      "confidence": 0.75,
      "evidence": "Diamond Resorts 'tra doi tac truoc' principle. Confirmed by VN wholesale market (cho dau moi) operating norms."
    },
    {
      "id": "DH-CF-004",
      "name": "Consultative Selling Cash Flow Multiplier",
      "condition": "B2B or high-value B2C sales where AOV can be increased by solution bundling",
      "heuristic": "Asking before pitching increases AOV 3-7x with same customer count. VN VLXD example: selling iron only = 29M order, 1.45M margin. Selling iron+cement+transport bundle = 85M order, 10.2M margin. Same customer, 7x margin. Cash flow impact: 175M/month additional from SAME 20 customers.",
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "evidence": "Rizwan + German + Diamond interview principles. SPIN Selling (Rackham): top 10% salespeople ask 4x more questions."
    },
    {
      "id": "DH-CF-005",
      "name": "Silence ROI in Negotiation",
      "condition": "Active negotiation with counterparty AND has BATNA (at least 1 real alternative)",
      "heuristic": "7 seconds of silence after counterparty's first offer yields average 3-5% better terms. On 2-year contracts, this compounds: 1000d/suat x 500 suat x 25 ngay x 24 thang = 300M from 7 seconds. Condition: MUST have BATNA. Without BATNA, silence = bluff that experienced counterparty will call.",
      "confidence": 0.65,
      "evidence": "Diamond Resorts 'pen on table' technique. Chris Voss tactical empathy framework."
    },
    {
      "id": "DH-CF-006",
      "name": "Reframe Beats Discount",
      "condition": "Customer requesting price reduction AND business has differentiation to justify value",
      "heuristic": "Reframing preserves margin permanently. Discounting destroys margin permanently (customers remember low price, never accept high price again). VN suat an example: reframe from 28K vs 25K/suat to 'ST25 rice = fewer sick days = 150M/month saved for factory'. Net: 900M/year margin protection from 1 reframing conversation.",
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "evidence": "Saygin CEO reframe principle. Kahneman & Tversky framing effect: same outcome, different frame = different decision."
    },
    {
      "id": "DH-CF-007",

Reason: predictable cash flow enables long-term leases, bank loans, employee retention, supplier contracts. VN cafe example: 90-110M/month consistent vs 30-180M/month volatile = same 100M average but consistent cafe can sign 3-year lease, get bank loan, hire permanent staff.",
